136:t_000:17.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Fine, but fighting the Empire's elite troops with this little strength is still going to be rough.」

136:t_000:18.en:
$$デュオ$$
「With $$カレン$$ and $$ゼクス$$ gone, and on top of that even that guy...」

136:t_000:19.en:
$$カトル$$
「That's enough, $$デュオ$$. The $$サイデリアル$$ are coming...!」

136:t_001:1.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Even for the $$黒の騎士団$$, this might be a little dicey this time...」

136:t_001:3.en:
$$ミレイ$$
「It'll be fine, $$ニーナ$$. The $$黒の騎士団$$... $$ゼロ$$ will never lose.」

136:t_001:4.en:
$$リヴァル$$
「Exactly! I stayed in $$新日本$$ to see the $$黒の騎士団$$ win, and the Council President stayed to report on it!」

136:t_001:5.en:
$$咲世子$$
「However, this place could become a battlefield too. Everyone, please evacuate.」

136:t_001:7.en:
$$咲世子$$
「Please don't worry about it. Protecting all of you and this academy is my duty.」

136:t_001:8.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They've sent out quite a number of them...!」

136:t_001:9.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Empire must be planning to take Tokyo in one fell swoop while it has the chance!」

136:t_001:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Tremble, Earthlings!」

136:t_001:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$...! Supreme commander of the $$新日本$$ conquest force!」

136:t_001:13.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(An enemy commander really showed up...!)

136:t_001:14.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(Everything is going as calculated so far. Let's see what you can do, $$ルルーシュ$$.)

136:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Gh...! They struck at the gaps in our deployment and let this many troops land...!」

136:t_001:16.en:
$$ギルター$$
「There's no need to be so pessimistic, $$ゼロ$$. You are not inferior. I am simply superior.」

136:t_001:18.en:
$$ギルター$$
「It must be written in this planet's books of strategy as well. 'Know your enemy and know yourself, and you will not be in peril in a hundred battles'... as they say.」

136:t_001:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「He has even studied Earth's culture...! This man... is different from any enemy so far!」

136:t_001:20.en:
$$ギルター$$
「In the end, you were only called a genius in skirmishes between Earthlings.」

136:t_001:21.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ is a renowned general among the $$サイデリアル$$, famous for his cunning. I am not an opponent your common sense to date will work against.」

136:t_001:22.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「W-wait, General $$ギルター$$...! With this much difference in strength, resisting is hopeless!」

136:t_001:23.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Oh ho... You mean the great $$ゼロ$$ is surrendering?」

136:t_001:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Naturally, not for nothing. I'll offer all the information on the $$地球連邦軍$$ that I know as my gift!」

136:t_001:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「So you're defecting. A wise but petty man.」

136:t_001:26.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's no lie...! As proof, I'll send you the information I have!」

136:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Oh...! So this is how the $$地球連邦軍$$ is deployed!」

136:t_002:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Damn it, silence! If you don't want to die too, follow me!」

136:t_002:3.en:
$$カトル$$
「I misjudged you! You weren't supposed to be that kind of man!」

136:t_002:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it! Where did the $$ゼロ$$ we believed in go!」

136:t_002:5.en:
$$玉城$$
「N-no way, $$ゼロ$$! Stop it! $$ゼロ$$!!」

136:t_002:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Quiet, all of you! Obey what $$ゼロ$$ has decided!」

136:t_002:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Thank you, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$. I believed you, of all people, would understand me.」

136:t_002:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「We've been together a long time. I understand everything about you.」

136:t_002:9.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn it, quit screwing around! Are you serious!?」

136:t_002:10.en:
$$カトル$$
「If it's come to this, we'll stop him with our own hands!」

136:t_002:11.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$ゼロ$$! Take our anger and our sorrow!」

136:t_002:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It can't be helped...! We'll meet them head-on, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$!」

136:t_002:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「General $$ギルター$$! Please give us cover fire!」

136:t_003:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What are you doing, General $$ギルター$$! I am seeking asylum with you!」

136:t_003:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I simply cannot trust a man like you. I judged it a better move to dispose of you here than to leave a worry for later.」

136:t_003:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I already have the information I need, and your distrust of each other keeps you from coordinating at all. The situation tilts entirely in my favor!」

136:t_003:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now, $$インセクト$$s! Devour the Earthlings!」

136:t_003:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You mean those $$アンゲロイ$$...!」

136:t_003:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Those carry artificial soldiers made from the genes of this planet's insects.」

136:t_003:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Their aggression and discipline have made them fine weapons.」

136:t_003:11.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「If it's come to this, we have no choice but to fight, $$ゼロ$$!」

136:t_003:13.en:
$$カトル$$
「Let's go, $$デュオ$$, $$ヒルデ$$, $$トロワ$$! Forget $$ゼロ$$!」

136:t_003:15.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Yeah! I don't care what happens to this country, but I'm not about to die in a place like this!」

136:t_003:18.en:
$$玉城$$
「D-damn it all!! Why did it have to come to this!!」

136:t_003:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Ha ha ha, weep! Scream! And then die!」

136:t_003:20.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ will bring down Tokyo! The legend of $$ゼロ$$ ends here today!」

136:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「They're holding out quite well with such a small force...! Earthlings are a tenacious lot!」

136:t_004:2.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Is there nothing we can do!」

136:t_004:3.en:
$$玉城$$
「Hang on, $$カトル$$, $$トロワ$$! I'll create the opening for a comeback!」

136:t_004:5.en:
$$玉城$$
「Shut up! I'm not taking orders from you!」

136:t_004:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Remember! This Tokyo is a city that rebuilt itself after the tragedy of 《$$フレイヤ$$》!」

136:t_004:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The feelings of the people are woven into this place... No one has the right to destroy it.」

136:t_004:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What you prepared for me is only a last resort. The time has not yet come.」

136:t_004:11.en:
$$玉城$$
「D-don't tell me... all that about defecting to the Empire was...」

136:t_004:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It was an act, of course.」
